steps.promotion_criteria: Direct recruitment through MPESB Police Constable Recruitment Test (Written CBT + Physical Proficiency Test), followed by 9 months basic police recruit training at Police Training Schools (PTS).
steps.source_label: MP Police Constable Recruitment Rulebook 2026, Section 4

steps.promotion_criteria: Promotion on seniority-cum-suitability basis after 8 to 10 years of service and successful completion of Head Constable Promotional Cadre Course (PCC), or through Limited Departmental Competitive Examination (LDCE).
steps.source_label: Madhya Pradesh Police Executive (Subordinate) Service Regulations

steps.promotion_criteria: Promotion based on seniority-cum-merit and clean service record after 5 to 6 years as Head Constable, with mandatory ASI pre-promotional training.
steps.source_label: MP Police Department Executive Cadre Guidelines

steps.promotion_criteria: Promotion through Departmental Promotion Committee (DPC) after prescribed qualifying service as ASI and qualifying the professional investigation and law module.
steps.source_label: MP Police Executive Service Promotion Rules

steps.designation: Inspector of Police (TI / थाना प्रभारी / निरीक्षक)
steps.promotion_criteria: Promotion on merit-cum-seniority from Sub-Inspector rank based on ACR gradings and successful leadership in police station commands.

steps.designation: Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP / उप पुलिस अधीक्षक)
steps.promotion_criteria: Induction into State Police Service (Gazetted Class I) via MPPSC DPC quota after distinguished service as Inspector.

papers.paper_name: Paper I: General Knowledge & Logic (40 marks), Intellectual Ability & Mental Aptitude (30 marks), Science & Simple Arithmetic (30 marks)

stages.stage_name: Second Stage Physical Proficiency Test (PPT / शारीरिक दक्षता परीक्षण)

papers.paper_name: Physical Efficiency Test: 800m Run (40 marks) + Shot Put / गोला फेंक (30 marks) + Long Jump / लंबी कूद (30 marks)

stages.source_label: MPESB Police Constable Rulebook 2026, Physical Proficiency Test Table

papers.paper_name: Physical Measurement (Height & Chest) and Verification of Original Educational & Caste Certificates

stages.source_label: MP Police Headquarters PST Verification Norms

financial_package.pay_source_label: MPESB Police Constable Rulebook 2026, Page 5, Clause 4

official_perks.perk_description: Dearness Allowance calculated at 58% of basic pay (₹11,310 per month at entry level) as per MP Finance Department orders.

official_perks.perk_name: Police Special Allowance & Extra Duty Pay
official_perks.perk_description: Special police allowances for law-and-order duties, night patrolling, and extra duty allowance for one additional month salary per year.
official_perks.source_label: MP Police Headquarters Special Pay Circulars

official_perks.perk_description: Annual uniform grant and monthly kit maintenance allowance for police personnel.
Allotment of departmental police line quarters or HRA between 8% and 16% of basic pay.
Defined Contributory Pension Scheme with 14% state government matching contribution.

cut_off_marks.note: Recruitment notification issued September 2026 for 7,500 Constable vacancies (700 Special Armed Force + 6,800 District Executive Force / Radio).
